name: Premier Health

ahrq.src: AHRQ Compendium of U.S. Health Systems, 2023, matched to CMS's hospital list (the site's June 2026 pull)

hc.src: Medicare hospital cost reports (CMS HCRIS, Worksheet S-3), fiscal year 2024 file

subs: Beds on its Medicare cost report. A licensed bed count usually runs higher.
Every intensive and special care unit counts: adult, cardiac, surgical, burn, neonatal and pediatric.
Each inpatient stay that ended counts once, whoever paid for it.
All inpatient days divided by discharges. Answer in days, like 4.5.
Patient days divided by the bed days it had available.
Medicare Advantage plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Medicaid managed care plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payroll only: not clinics, not contract staff.
Interns and residents: doctors training after medical school. Two half-time count as one.
From AHRQ's 2023 list of who owns which hospital, matched to Medicare's hospital list.
Every one of its hospitals' latest Medicare cost report, added up.
Biggest by beds on its cost report. The answer names the hospital.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payrolls only: clinics, offices and any health plan are left out.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Miami Valley Hospital have on its payroll in 2024?
questions.why: No other Premier Health hospital reports more; Atrium Medical Center is next at 987. About 5.3 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Atrium Medical Center have on its payroll in 2024?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Premier Health hospitals; Miami Valley Hospital has the most, 5,014. About 4.0 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Upper Valley Medical Center have on its payroll in 2024?
questions.why: That is the fewest of 3 Premier Health hospitals; Miami Valley Hospital has the most, 5,014. About 5.5 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent resident physicians trained at Miami Valley Hospital in 2024?
questions.why: Interns and residents: doctors training after medical school. Two half-time count as one.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees do Premier Health's hospitals have on payroll, added together?
questions.why: From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2024.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent resident physicians train in Premier Health's hospitals, added together?
questions.why: One of its hospitals reports residents; Miami Valley Hospital trains the most, 205.

questions.q: What percent of Miami Valley Hospital's inpatient days in 2024 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: That is the lowest of 3 Premier Health hospitals; Upper Valley Medical Center runs highest, 68 percent. Traditional Medicare was 18 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 35 percent.

questions.q: How many hospitals does Premier Health run, by the federal list of health systems?
questions.why: All of them are in Ohio. A system's own count can differ: it may count campuses on their own, or hospitals that joined after 2023.
